dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #Thanks to Nara {NICKNAME}'s help, the Song Gatherers have learned many songs that had been forgotten many sunrises ago,

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: These songs, to Aranara, are like Nara's "treasure."

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: #The song gatherers and Nara {NICKNAME} went to look for treasures together, and are good friends.
